trust.title: The rail is Stellar. The experience is not.
trust.line: The blockchain is not the product.
trust.left: Stellar moves the value in seconds, with tiny fees. Stablecoins travel as infrastructure: fast, stable, and out of sight.
trust.right: The person who receives does not create a Senda account, sign a transaction, or learn a network. They see pesos in Mercado Pago. That is the design.

items.question: Do I need to download an app?
items.answer: No. You write on WhatsApp, like texting someone you know. The recipient gets paid in Mercado Pago.

items.question: What does Stellar do here?
items.answer: It moves value fast and cheap, underneath. It is infrastructure. The screen is the chat and the credit in pesos.

items.question: Can I send from any country?
items.answer: That is the product idea: anyone in the world sends to Argentina. That is the first corridor we open.

items.question: How long does it take, and what does it cost?
items.answer: Most transfers settle in minutes. The fee is shown before you confirm. Numbers on this page are examples.

items.question: Why not just use Western Union or Wise?
items.answer: They cover the world, but the Argentine last mile is still friction: a branch, an extra app, or a destination the family does not already use.
